Smart Beginning · newborn to age 5 · ad-free

Colours & 3D Shapes

First things first — with Kinni
Red like my blanket heart. Yellow like Duck. Shall we find them all?

Why this comes first

Sorting by colour and shape is the earliest maths skill — it comes before counting and before letters. A child who can tell a cube from a sphere is already doing geometry, and every letter later is learned as a shape.

Early Reading

Read with Mira
Letters are just shapes with a sound hiding inside. Shall we find some?

Why this comes next

Hearing a letter's sound and finding its shape is how reading begins — long before writing whole words.

Watch & Learn

Hand-picked videos · needs internet

These are real YouTube videos made by other people. Each one opens in the YouTube app, so a grown-up should watch alongside. This build has no parental filter or time limit on videos yet — treat this section as grown-up-supervised only.

Little One Mode

Just look and listen — nothing to tap
👁️

High-contrast faces, one at a time

Hold the device about 20-30cm from your baby's face. High-contrast black, white and red patterns are easiest for very young eyes to focus on.

Characters

Tap to hear their voice and see their poses

Story logic

Every module is owned by one character. When a child struggles, the owning character — never a system voice — asks the gentler version of the question. Trust the character, keep the challenge.
